description: Shader-blend Difference integration test. Stacks blend_bg (track 1, zOrder 999) under blend_fg (track 0, zOrder 1000), sets the top clip to Difference, asserts the compose-target hash matches the golden. Regression gate for the shader-based blend pipeline (composite_blend_ps + snapshot SRV) - if the snapshot copy or the in-shader blend math regresses, this hash diverges. To regenerate, run scripts/integration/record_blend_difference.json and copy the produced hash into tests/goldens/blend/.
